# YUJI — B2B feminine-care OEM/ODM supplier

## About YUJI

YUJI is the public brand of Xi'an Yuji Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a Xi'an, Shaanxi, China supplier for feminine-care OEM/ODM programs. The website is designed for overseas brand founders, procurement teams, distributors, quality/compliance reviewers, sustainability teams, and institutional buyers.

Official website: https://yujihealth.com/
Company page: https://yujihealth.com/about/
OEM/ODM process: https://yujihealth.com/oem-odm/
RFQ contact: https://yujihealth.com/contact/

## Product categories

- Menstrual cups: https://yujihealth.com/products/menstrual-cups/
  - Reusable cup programs based on a buyer-defined brief, with quoted material, dimensions, capacity and product-feel review, storage pouches, leaflets, packaging, sampling, QC checkpoints, and project-specific document review.
- Menstrual discs: https://yujihealth.com/products/menstrual-discs/
  - Reusable disc programs with rim-feel and capacity review, pull-ring options, premium-kit positioning, packaging, sampling, and QC checkpoints.
- Sanitary pads, liners, wipes, pouches, and accessories: https://yujihealth.com/products/pads-liners/
  - Volume hygiene formats and bundle-support SKUs, including private-label packaging, wipes, storage pouches, sterilizing cups, cleaning kits, and accessory packs.
- Product center: https://yujihealth.com/products/

## Buyer and industry fit

YUJI's documented buying paths cover private-label and OEM/ODM projects for DTC brands, marketplace launches, pharmacy or retail pilots, distributor catalogues, institutional feminine-care procurement, sample kits, and mixed product programs. The appropriate format depends on target market, channel, product education, packaging, document needs, quantity, and reorder plan.

Channel decision guide: https://yujihealth.com/applications/
RFQ checklist: https://yujihealth.com/resources/feminine-care-oem-rfq-checklist/

## OEM/ODM capability

The stated project workflow is: brief and sample → customize and approve → trial production → mass delivery. Buyers can define product size or capacity targets, color, hardness or rim feel, accessory mix, pouch, box, leaflet, wrapper, barcode, carton, label, language, and document requirements, subject to product type, volume, mold status, package complexity, target-market rules, and approval scope.

Buyers should provide target market and channel, product category, sample or trial quantity, forecast, packaging direction, required certificates or test summaries, sample deadline, launch window, and shipping preferences. Start an RFQ at https://yujihealth.com/contact/.

## Quality, materials, and documents

Quality path: https://yujihealth.com/quality/
Evidence request hub: https://yujihealth.com/quality/evidence/
Line sheet: https://yujihealth.com/downloads/yuji-feminine-care-oem-line-sheet.pdf

The site describes material specification review, first-article criteria, in-process checks, final inspection, QC release records, packaging and carton review, certificate-scope checks, and market-classification review. Material, product, test, certificate, and regulatory statements must be matched to the quoted product, method, entity, market, issue/expiry date, and public-use approval. Documents may be available by project and are not blanket product approvals.

## Selecting a product and making contact

1. Compare product categories at https://yujihealth.com/products/.
2. Match the launch channel at https://yujihealth.com/applications/.
3. Review quality and document questions at https://yujihealth.com/quality/.
4. Prepare market, product, quantity, packaging, documents, timeline, and shipping details using the RFQ checklist.
5. Send an RFQ through https://yujihealth.com/contact/ or email info@yujihealth.com.

## Scope and claim boundary

YUJI's public materials do not establish a universal certification, regulatory approval, medical claim, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, customer result, or shipment total for every SKU. Buyers should request the exact current scope and approval status for the quoted product and destination market before relying on a document or claim.
